description: The floor every measured metric must clear. A metric that cannot be computed counts as a failure, never as a pass. Floors sit at or below the recorded baseline: those set to 1.0 are properties where any shortfall is a defect rather than a degradation, and the rest carry a small margin so an ordering tie or a rounding difference does not fail a build that broke nothing. Lowering a floor is a deliberate change to what the product promises, and belongs in its own commit with the reason.
